title: Sable and the Ghost
author: August Almeida
blurb: Dominic Zhou, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
